target_identity: Owner of a difficult real problem who is willing and able to descend all the way into fundamental research when the problem demands it.

P1.label: Consequential concrete problem
P1.test: Name the real system, scientific program or capability that is constrained, and the consequence.

P2.label: Problem pulls the research gap
P2.test: Attempt to solve the problem exposes the blocker; targeted research feeds understanding back into that problem. Novelty alone is insufficient.

P3.label: Growing intellectual/problem ownership
P3.test: Student increasingly owns hypotheses, discriminating probes, interpretation and next decisions; execution ownership alone is insufficient.

P4.label: Cumulative long-horizon progress
P4.test: Projects accumulate toward better explanation, prediction, control or capability rather than unrelated publishable topics.

P5.label: Scientific/technical identity fit
P5.test: Physics, mathematical/scientific reasoning or deep systems investigation must be substantive. Difficult generic implementation alone is insufficient; architecture and numerical-method research remain eligible.

P6.label: Hard feedback and meaningful closure
P6.test: Validate against physical evidence, observations, system measurements or appropriate rigorous numerical/mathematical evidence.

P7.label: Named project and doctoral route
P7.test: Facility/ecosystem coverage is not an actionable PhD destination until PI, role and route are identified.

F1.label: Explicit directionless-Floquet exclusion
F1.test: Do not focus on phase/phenomenon demonstrations without an identified consequential problem they are needed to solve. This does not reject Floquet methods used to solve such a problem.

F2.label: Fabrication/characterization dominates
F2.test: Exclude projects dominated by process fabrication or prescribed characterization rather than desired scientific/model/system ownership; group portfolio alone does not prove this failure.

E1.label: Evidence insufficient for focus
E1.test: Hold outside active focus pending project/thesis evidence; this is not a rejection or evidence of weak research.
